svg.aria-label: Tape, finish, paint and baseboard (printed page 26)
svg.text: Tape, finish, paint and baseboard (printed page 26)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
CONDITIONAL: board/compound system and finish surfaces first
02. At the pantry inside corner shown on the preceding plate, if an accepted fixed joint is specified,
bed folded paper tape into compound along the W1-P/W2-P seam. Use the selected movement-joint detail
instead if the connection requires movement.
03. At the room outside corner, fit the selected corner bead to the W1-R lap over W2-R, fasten or embed
it by its own instructions, then coat and feather each side.
05. Measure visible finished W1 room face, W2 faces and EX1 returns for matching new baseboard. Reuse
sound labeled trim where practical; cut new pieces to measured returns and attach to verified wood,
avoiding service paths and the tile.
Baseboard behind flush cabinets and the refrigerator is decided from the real cabinet/appliance
clearance instructions. Trim removal does not require tile removal or authorize anchor drilling.
Source family: r35-p26-finish.svg · printed page 26 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
